cases.name: bilingual-columns
review: Preserve Turkish diacritics and decimal comma.
Read each column coherently; do not interleave unrelated sentences.
Keep 42.75/42,75 MPa and 23 °C attached to their quantities.

cases.name: table-equation-figure
review: Table cells must remain associated with the correct specimen.
Preserve σ, E, ε and multiplication without changing meaning.
Identify Figure 1 and do not invent experimental evidence.

cases.name: scanned-rotated-bilingual
review: Recover rotated raster text without relying on native PDF text.
Preserve Turkish diacritics, pressure values, and temperature.

limits: Token presence is a regression signal, not human reading-order/citation acceptance.
These generated fixtures do not represent all scans, equations, or malformed PDFs.
